rules.statement: A notary is responsible for stating definitely any erasures, alterations, or interpolations in both the original and duplicate deeds as required by sub-section 22 of section 3 of Ordinance No. 21 of 1900.
rules.supporting_quote: "I believe it has been held by this Court that a deed, whether original or duplicate, is valid without an attestation. It is also plain to me from the phrases used in the schedule of the Notaries' Ordinance, No. 2 of 1877, that a duplicate must be attested; that, therefore, the provisions of sub-sections 21 and 22 of section 3 of the Notaries' Ordinance, No. 21 of 1900, must necessarily apply to duplicates as well as to originals;"
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 3, sub-section 26, of Ordinance No. 21 of 1900 or null
